verdict.rationale: Moneybird supports non-interactive automation: a REST API, a CLI for the terminal on the same API, personal API tokens with selectable scopes that avoid an interactive OAuth flow, and self-serve sandbox administrations for testing integrations. However, the CLI appears only as a one-line mention, and nothing describes running in CI specifically. missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, flags, non-interactive or env-var auth), explicit CI/headless usage guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
Alternatively, you can create a personal API token that simplifies the setup, at a cost of security.
For a personal API token, you can use the checkboxes to select the scopes you need.
We offer special sandbox administrations to test your API integration.
